description: DirMO-24 feat30 exactly as dirmo_24_feat30_pw4_d12_stack25_rawdf (DS: team recipe, mean of seeds 42/1/2, 4x loss weight on observed speed >= 550 km/s, leads 1-12 from a delta-target block-0 model, leads 25-72 moved by 0.25 x a level-free LightGBM residual model fit on out-of-fold forecasts of the training rows, on the team raw-only df), followed by one post-processing step, post-processing only, no fitted parameters, no retraining: each final 72-lead forecast row, on its own, is replaced on leads 25-72 by the piecewise-straight line through its own values at lead 1, at its minimum, at its maximum and at lead 72, joined to the forecast on leads 25-30 by forecast + ((h - 24) / 6) x (line - forecast), then clipped to 1-3000 km/s; leads 1-24 are unchanged. No other row and no truth is read by this step. The submitted predictions are the submitted DS predictions with this step applied (leads 1-24 bit-identical to DS); the replay script retrains DS and applies the step, and its full run reproduces the submitted file to max |diff| 1.1e-13 km/s. Lab check (jsy301 round SV arm A2, pre-registered, 5 windows 2023-07..2025-12 on the same df, raw truth): all leads -1.23 % vs DS [CI99.5 -2.34, -0.22], every window better, -0.79 % after removing the mean level change; it failed that round's -2 % gate. Submitted as a board-transfer measurement of a parameter-free lab gain (round BT; reading thresholds vs DS fixed before submission: <= -0.6 % transfers, >= -0.2 % does not). Not chosen by any board number.

data.gap_fill: inputs causal last value (observations unlimited, images <= 24 h, ENLIL none); y never filled
data.time_convention: newest input of origin O is the hour labelled O-1h; lead h target is hour O+h
data.training_rows: df fit_F1/fit_F2/fit_F3 (origin + 144 h <= cutoff), hourly origins

hyperparameters.base_score: block mean of the observed training targets (scalar)

loss_weight.rule: 4 if observed y >= 550 km/s else 1; 0 on missing y; mean 1 per lead over observed rows

a2.knots: lead 1, argmin, argmax and lead 72 of the final forecast row over leads 1-72 (duplicate knots merged), straight lines between them (np.interp)
a2.note: post-processing only, no fitted parameters (DirMO lab round SV arm A2, lab/sv_post.py a2_curve + taper); applied after the stack and the short model, each row on its own, then clip(1, 3000)
a2.taper: forecast on leads 1-24, forecast + ((h-24)/6)(A2 - forecast) on leads 25-30, A2 from lead 30

short_leads.note: block-0 model on y - v_lag0 (same inputs, 4x@550 on the speed); its leads 1-12 replace the main
